prerequisites: It is recommended to have previously taken the compulsory third-year subjects Mechanical Technology and Manufacturing Technologies.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and capacities to apply the scientific and technological fundamentals of joining technologies.

syllabus_topics: Alumino-thermic welding. Electron beam and laser welding. Electroslag and electrogas welding
Solid-state welding process. Electric resistance welding. Friction and explosion welding
teaching_methods: Distance learning following the UNED methodological model.
Didactic resources and activities available sequentially through the Virtual Course.
Flexible study planning allowing adaptation to diverse personal and work circumstances.
Promotion of autonomous work through various activities, utilizing Virtual Course communication tools such as forums.
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.8 * In-person Examination Grade + 0.2 * PEC Grade. To compute the PEC grade, the student must have passed the In-person Examination. The minimum grade for the in-person examination to pass without the PEC is 6.2, and 5 to be able to add the PEC. If the PEC is not submitted, the maximum final grade for the subject is 8. The PEC is only submitted in the ordinary call (February), but its grade is saved for the extraordinary call (September).
